create_entry.default: You're set. Use Assist as usual; you'll be told when there's something to review. Nothing in your home changes until you accept.

export_recording.name: Export recording
export_recording.description: Return one recording as JSON. Includes household conversations; administrators only.

check_replay_fidelity.name: Check replay fidelity
check_replay_fidelity.description: Rebuild a recorded conversation's home in a sandbox and compare Assist's system prompt and tools there with the recorded ones. No AI model is called.

replay_recording.name: Replay a recording
replay_recording.description: Replay a recorded conversation's first turns with the assistant it used, in a sandbox, and report whether the assistant changed the same devices the same way. Calls that assistant's AI model; nothing is stored.

last_turn.name: Last turn
last_turn.description: Replay up to this user turn (the first by default).

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Required: each turn is one or more calls to the assistant's model.

list_improvements.name: List improvements
list_improvements.description: The tested improvements, with their status, tests and decisions. Makes no AI requests and changes nothing.
